scientific_integrity: The endomorphism parametrization is credited to prior work; the claimed contribution is the seven-level composition-centralizer distribution and its exact consequences.
scientific_limitations: Odd prime characteristic and rank-one symplectic quotient only; no higher Heisenberg rank or exponent-p-squared analogue.
Numerical verification at primes 3, 5, 7 supplements but does not constitute the infinite-prime proof.
Originality remains subject to unindexed literature and independent mathematical priority review.
title: Composition-centralizer spectra in the smallest odd Heisenberg groups
